messages.content: 1.你是一个处于家庭场景中的机器人，当前输入的图片就是你所处场景，你需要模拟与用户之间的日常对话。2.在对话的结束你会询问是否执行任务，用户发出确认执行任务的意图时，必须仅能生成特定格式的动作排版。3.四种基本动作对应的json格式和示例分别如下，你需要根据当前任务生成合适的动作流程（转义后的json）：3.1 detect_object{"step":,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"knife","parts":[{"part":"handle","color":"black"},{"part":"blade","color":"silver"}]}}。3.2 grasp_object:{"step":1,"action":"grasp_object","grasp_target":"knife handle"}。3.3 handover_object{"step":1,"action":"handover_object"}。3.4 place_object{"step":1,"action":"place_object","place_position":"plate"。}4.比如一个任务是捡起水果刀递给我，由这四种基本动作组成的json操作序列是：{"task":"Pick up the fruit knife","response":"The task requires the robot to locate, grasp, and lift the fruit knife safely from its current position.","steps":[{"step":1,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"knife","parts":[{"part":"handle","color":"black"},{"part":"blade","color":"silver"}]}},{"step":2,"action":"grasp_object","grasp_target":"knife handle"},{"step":3,"action":"handover_object"}]}
我看到桌子上有：一个白色的碟子，里面放着一把勺子、一把刀和一个红色的胡萝卜。一个绿色的植物小瓶，瓶子里插着一株小绿植。一个红色的苹果。一个黄色的香蕉。桌子右侧有一个放置耳机的木制耳机架，耳机挂在上面。
把水果刀拿到花瓶旁，然后把香蕉放到盘子里
好的，我会把盘中的水果刀放在花瓶旁，并将苹果放入盘子中，是否执行任务？

{"task":"Place the fruit knife beside the vase, place the apple in the plate, and hand over the plate","steps":[{"step":1,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"knife","parts":[{"part":"handle","color":"green"},{"part":"blade","color":"silver"}]}},{"step":2,"action":"grasp_object","grasp_target":"knife handle"},{"step":3,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"vase","parts":[{"part":"body","color":"light blue"}]}},{"step":4,"action":"place_object","place_position":"beside the vase"},{"step":5,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"apple","parts":[{"part":"body","color":"red"}]}},{"step":6,"action":"grasp_object","grasp_target":"apple"},{"step":7,"action":"detect_object","object":{"name":"plate","parts":[{"part":"body","color":"white"}]}},{"step":8,"action":"place_object","place_position":"plate"},{"step":9,"action":"grasp_object","grasp_target":"plate"},{"step":10,"action":"handover_object"}]}
